summary: A homeowner on {street} asks whose bill it is when a city tree lifts the sidewalk beside the paving job.
realLife: Oakland's proposed corridor work distinguished damage from municipal trees from private sidewalk repairs handled through reimbursement agreements.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: sidewalk inspection, tree ownership and applicable payment agreement.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: sidewalk inspection, tree ownership and applicable payment agreement.
turns.what: Add the verified city-tree repair to the corridor work order.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: sidewalk inspection, tree ownership and applicable payment agreement.
turns.what: Identify the responsible payer and put the outstanding municipal repair on the sidewalk list.
